 ▲ candle   SETUP   nothing trades until your agent and its limits exist                                                
                                                                                                                        
 ╭─ Setup ──────────────────╮ ╭───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── step 1 of 5 ─╮ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ ✓ Welcome                │ │  Sign in to Candle                                                                    │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ ▸ Sign in to Candle      │ │  This machine has no keychain, so the Candle CLI keeps its sign-in in a file locked   │ 
 │                          │ │  by a passphrase you choose. The Candle Harness reads it when it starts, so set it    │ 
 │ · Connect your agent     │ │  first:                                                                               │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ · Wallet and limits      │ │    echo 'export CANDLE_KEYRING_PASSPHRASE="<a passphrase of your own>"' >> ~/.bashrc  │ 
 │                          │ │  ▸ ⧉ Copy the line                               then put your own passphrase in it   │ 
 │ · The tour               │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │  Then quit (ctrl-c twice), open a new terminal, and run candle-harness again. Keep    │ 
 │ · Where to start         │ │  the same passphrase from then on.                                                    │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │  This isn't a vault's passphrase. It only locks the CLI's sign-in file on this        │ 
 │                          │ │  machine; a vault, if you make one, has its own.                                      │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ about 3 minutes          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ quit any time: it picks  │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ up where you stopped     │ │                                                                                       │
